def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    if valid_mask.any():
        # For valid bins (those that can fit the item), prioritize smaller remaining space
        # This favors bins that are closer to full but still have enough room
        priorities[valid_mask] = 1 / (remaining[valid_mask] + 1e-9)
        # Normalize to make sure higher priority for tighter fits
        priorities[valid_mask] = (priorities[valid_mask] - priorities[valid_mask].min()) / (priorities[valid_mask].max() - priorities[valid_mask].min() + 1e-9)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if valid_mask.any():
        unit = 0.1
        remainder = remaining[valid_mask] % unit
        closeness = 1 - np.abs(remainder - unit/2) / (unit/2)
        priorities[valid_mask] = closeness
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    if valid_mask.any():
        fill_ratio = item / (remaining[valid_mask] + item + 1e-9)
        target_ratio = 0.5
        ratio_diff = np.abs(fill_ratio - target_ratio)
        priorities[valid_mask] = 1.0 / (ratio_diff + 1e-9)
        if priorities[valid_mask].max() - priorities[valid_mask].min() > 1e-9:
            priorities[valid_mask] = (priorities[valid_mask] - priorities[valid_mask].min()) / (priorities[valid_mask].max() - priorities[valid_mask].min() + 1e-9)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    # Avoid negative or zero capacity by clamping to a small positive value
    remaining_capacity = np.maximum(remaining_capacity, 1e-8)
    # Define an ideal remaining capacity around half the bin size for balance
    ideal_remaining = bins / 2.0
    # Compute deviation from ideal remaining capacity
    deviation = np.abs(remaining_capacity - ideal_remaining)
    # Lower deviation means higher priority
    priorities = 1.0 / (deviation + 1e-8)
    # Normalize priorities to ensure meaningful relative ranking
    priorities = (priorities - priorities.min()) / (priorities.max() - priorities.min() + 1e-8)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    loads = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # Assuming bins are initially empty, so loads start at 0
    # Use remaining capacity as proxy for priority: higher remaining capacity is better
    remaining_capacity = bins - loads
    # Prioritize bins with more remaining capacity, but penalize very small remaining capacity
    # This encourages using bins efficiently without overfilling
    priorities = remaining_capacity
    # Ensure no negative priorities
    priorities = np.maximum(priorities, 0)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.fmin(bins, item)
    return remaining
